incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to #incidents — Severity: SeV2. Observed: sustained tail latency >5s and 10-15% 5xx for model-serving pool 'dedicated-1' starting at 1881234562. Potential root: KV-cache thrash after a large prefix load. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-evict 

Oncall Alex: grabbing page. I can take an initial look. Is this from a deploy or traffic spike?

SRE Mike: no deploy markers in the last 30m. Metrics show a sudden increase in long-context hits. KV hit-rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.36. That suggests cache eviction churn.

Eng James: I'm seeing repeated OOM OOM_SCORE spikes on runtime nodes 7-9 in logs: `oom_kill_process` around 1881234540. Could be memory pressure from large kv entries.

Oncall Alex: mitigation plan — step 1 throttle incoming long-context requests to this pool, step 2 evict largest KV namespaces, step 3 rollback any suspect model variant. Doing step 1 now: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/ratelimit/pool/dedicated-1 -d '{"qps":50}'`

ops-bot: Rate limit applied to pool dedicated-1: QPS=50.

SRE Mike: I'm executing targeted KV eviction for namespaces tagged `session:prefetch` on nodes 7-9. Command snippet: ```bash
for n in 7 8 9; do
  ssh node-$n "/opt/redwood/bin/kvtool evict --namespace session:prefetch --max-age 300"
done
```

Eng Jennifer: rolled back model variant v2.3 -> v2.1 on dedicated-1 at 1881234625. Observing latency beginning to improve (p50 back to ~120ms).

PM Clara: customer impact assessment — initial telemetry flags two high-value customers (AcmeRetail, id=cust-9045; MediSync, id=cust-1122) saw increased errors and timeouts between 1881234560-1881234680. Estimated affected requests: Acme ~12k calls, MediSync ~3.4k calls.

Eng James: confirmed error-rate for AcmeRetail peaked at 18% 5xx, most were 503/504. We'll need to surface this in postmortem and discuss credits.

Oncall Alex: handing mitigation to SRE Mike for follow-up and persistent fixes. I need to get some sleep — next oncall is Eng Jennifer (starts 1881234800).

SRE Mike: taking over. Immediate next actions: monitor for recurrence, collect heap dumps from nodes 7-9, and snapshot kv-metrics for the period. Also creating an incident channel subthread for customer comms.

incident-bot: New incident channel created: #incident-1881234567-kv-thrash.

PM Clara: can we schedule a post-incident review? I propose tomorrow 14:00 UTC (1881310967) or if that doesn't work, Friday 09:00 UTC. Need SRE, runtime eng, product, and support on the call.

Eng Jennifer: I can do tomorrow 14:00.

Eng James: Friday 09:00 works better for me.

SRE Mike: either works; prefer tomorrow so we can triage immediate action items before next sprint planning.

PM Clara: okay — tentative tomorrow 14:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invite to attendees. Agenda: timeline, root cause hypothesis, action items, customer remediation, and quarterly roadmap tie-ins.

SRE Mike: quick root cause notes: 1) resumed long-context prefetching without sizing guardrails, 2) no canary for large-KV workload, 3) memory accounting for kv entries underestimates compound frames.

Eng James: propose immediate action items (with rough size estimates):
- ACTION-1: Add memory accounting and eviction thresholds to KV service (owner: SRE Mike) — estimate: 2w, priority: P0, quarter tie-in: Q2 runtime hardening.
- ACTION-2: Postmortem doc + customer impact summary + credits proposal (owner: PM Clara) — estimate: 3d, priority: P0.
- ACTION-3: Add unit/integration canary for large-prefetch flows in CI (owner: Eng Jennifer) — estimate: 1w, priority: P1.
- ACTION-4: Temporary rate-limit guard at the routing layer for long-context (>8k tokens) requests (owner: Eng James) — estimate: 3d, priority: P0.
- ACTION-5: Billing/backfill review for AcmeRetail + MediSync (owner: Eng James) — estimate: small (1-2d), priority: P1.

PM Clara: I'll convert those into tracked issues in the incident tracker and tag each with quarter mapping. ACTION-1 maps to Q2 infra sprint; ACTION-3 we'll slot as Q2 dev-qa; ACTION-4 can be a hotfix this sprint.

Oncall Alex: handoff note for next oncall (Jennifer): watch for reappearance on nodes 7-9, check `kv:evict` metrics, and verify no downstream customer retries thrash.

Eng Jennifer: got it. I'll follow up on the canary task and start a draft for the postmortem doc after the calendar invite.

SRE Mike: uploading core captures and heap snapshots to the incident bucket now (s3://incidents/1881234567/). Also adding links to perf graphs and a short reproduction script.

incident-bot: Evidence uploaded: s3://incidents/1881234567/{heap-node7.dmp,heap-node8.dmp,kv-metrics-1881234560-1881234700.json}.

PM Clara: customer comms draft (for review): "We experienced intermittent elevated errors for a subset of inference requests between 14:02-14:12 UTC due to internal cache eviction behavior after a large prefetch. We mitigated by throttling and rolling back a recently used variant. We are preparing a full post-incident report and will propose remediation credits if appropriate." Please review and add channel-specific notes.

Eng James: suggested wording: call out the precise window and impacted call volumes for AcmeRetail and MediSync. Also include a pointer to the postmortem when available.

PM Clara: noted. I'll finalize after the postmortem draft.

SRE Mike: final operational note — we should add an automated threshold that flips long-prefetch flows into a secondary pool with stricter memory caps. I'll add as subtask under ACTION-1.

Eng Jennifer: quick FYI — I added a small unit test to CI that simulates kv churn; forcing it to run on this incident branch. Will open PR and link in the incident tracker.

PM Clara: summary of agreed action items (I will create tracker tickets):
- ticket: KV memory accounting & eviction thresholds (owner: SRE Mike, estimate: 2w, priority: P0, quarter: Q2)
- ticket: Postmortem + customer impact + credits (owner: PM Clara, estimate: 3d, priority: P0)
- ticket: Long-prefetch canary in CI (owner: Eng Jennifer, estimate: 1w, priority: P1)
- ticket: Routing guard for >8k token requests (owner: Eng James, estimate: 3d, priority: P0)
- ticket: Billing review and customer comms finalization (owner: Eng James & PM Clara, estimate: 1-2d, priority: P1)

Oncall Alex: thumbs up. Thanks team. Handing off to Eng Jennifer for next watch window.

Eng Jennifer: taking over monitoring. I'll post any follow-ups here and update the incident tracker with PR links.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Incident channel: #incident-1881234567-kv-thrash. Postmortem scheduled by PM Clara for 1881310967 (tentative).

PM Clara: thanks all. I'll close the loop after the meeting and publish the postmortem doc with action-item owners and timeline. :white_check_mark:
